• Cloudflare cut 20%+ of staff despite record growth
• Prince says the interns hired are AI-native builders and sellers
• The company received nearly 1M applications for 1,111 internships
• Prince says AI lets managers oversee more people with better measurement
• Cloudflare is moving from periodic audits to continuous AI-driven monitoring
• Most cuts hit “measurer” roles across management, ops, finance, audit & marketing
